description: Read back what a hosted frontend version is made of: every file with its size and its URL on that version, and the full text of the text files (HTML, CSS, JS, JSON, SVG...). This is how a new conversation continues a site an earlier one built: "take my Krispool site and keep going" starts here, not from scratch. For a site written by hand the files ARE the source. For a bundled build (Vite, React) the JS is minified output: fine to inspect, not something to edit, so ask for the project's source instead. Images and other binaries come back as URLs only. Text is capped at 512KB per file and 4MB per call; narrow with `paths` for a big site. To start another app from this version, or bring an old version back as a new one, use deploy_frontend with fromAppId.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

includeContent.description: false lists the files without their text, a cheap first look at a large site. Default true

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

paths.description: Only these files, as listed by a previous call, e.g. ["index.html", "css/site.css"]

version.description: Version to read (from list_deployments). Default: the live version

name: get_deployment_files
